label: gl-vk-offscreen-scratch-pool, before: a disposed scRGB offscreen stays in Skia's scratch pool, keyed by its size
kind: real-window Vulkan probes, not a perf-suite capture (the suite never builds SkiaVulkanRenderSurface)
machine: SPELDATOR, i7-14700K, RTX 4080 driver 610.62, Windows 11 26200, HDR display 4K at 150%, 120 Hz
configuration: Release, HULTUI_A11Y=0, SDL_WINDOW_ACTIVATE_WHEN_SHOWN=0, HULTUI_VULKAN_F16=1, HULTUI_VULKAN_PRESENT=mailbox, P-cores, idle-gated before every run, before and after alternated (ABBA)

probes.scratch: a scratch-pad probe window (title, five shadowed cards, twelve text rows in a full-width box at opacity 0.85), resized with SetWindowPos NOACTIVATE on the UI thread, two forced frames after each. sizes = 28 resizes cycling 1500x940, 1400x880, 1700x1060, 1600x1000 window px; drag = 40 resizes, each a new size, +12 x +8 px a step from 1600x1000; toggle = 40 resizes between two sizes. Memory read in-process: Skia GetResourceCacheUsage (budgeted only), Skia DumpMemoryStatistics (every resource, live or purgeable), DXGI IDXGIAdapter3::QueryVideoMemoryInfo for the process (local), nvidia-smi memory.used for the whole GPU minus a reading before the window, Task Manager's GPU Process Memory dedicated counter
probes.vulkanProbe: tests/HultUI.UiTests.VulkanProbe --resizes=40 (8a38ef4's probe: two red/blue boxes, two sizes) and --resizes=40 --new-sizes (each resize a new size); median time SetWindowPos took, the window procedure drawing the new size inside it

memoryAfterResizes.what the pool held after the 4-size run: the first offscreen (1350x900, 9.27 MB), three of the four sizes' offscreens (8.66, 9.97, 12.85 MB; the fourth is in use), a 2048x1024 F16 opacity-layer texture (16.00 MB) and small buffers

unbudgetedAlone.note: the offscreen created with budgeted: false, nothing else changed (one run each)
unbudgetedAlone.skiaBudgetedAtStartMB: 19.7 -> 10.4 while DXGI read 130.6 both times: GetResourceCacheUsage leaves the live unbudgeted surface out

gl.note: the GL renderer has no exact-size offscreen; its pool holds approximately-sized layer textures only (RGBA8, Skia's size bins)
